name: Medical Care
description: Medical services to diagnose and/or treat a medical condition, illness, or injury

name: Surgical
description: Surgical services provided by a healthcare provider

name: Consultation
description: Counseling and/or coordination of care with other Physicians, other qualified Healthcare Providers or agencies

name: Diagnostic X-Ray
description: Diagnostic x-ray provided by a healthcare provider

name: Diagnostic Lab
description: Diagnostic lab provided by a healthcare provider

name: Radiation Therapy
description: Radiation therapy provided by a healthcare provider

name: Anesthesia
description: Anesthesia services provided by a healthcare provider

name: Surgical Assistance
description: Assistant surgeon/surgical assistance provided by a healthcare provider if required because of the complexity of the surgical procedures

name: Hearing Aid
description: Small electronic device that is worn in or above the ear.

name: Blood
description: The allotment of whole blood, blood plasma, or blood derivatives

name: Durable Medical Equipment Used
description: Used equipment needed for medical reasons to be used by a person that is ill or injured and is ordered by a health care provider for use in the home.

name: Durable Medical Equipment Purchased
description: Purchased equipment needed for medical reasons to be used by a person that is ill or injured and is ordered by a healthcare provider for use in the home.

name: Hearing Aid Power Source
description: Batteries or other type of device used to charge a hearing aid

name: Durable Medical Equipment Rental
description: Rental equipment needed for medical reasons to be used by a person that is ill or injured and is ordered by a healthcare provider for use in the home.

name: Pneumonia Vaccine
description: Services provided by a physician or other healthcare provider related to administration of Pneumococcal Pneumonia vaccination.

name: Second Surgical Opinion
description: Second professional opinion sought to verify or confirm the necessity for surgical procedures

name: Diagnostic Dental
description: The translation of data gathered by clinical and radiographic examination into an organized, classified definition of conditions present.

name: Periodontics
description: The art and science of examination, diagnosis, and treatment of diseases affecting the periodontium; a study of the supporting structures of the teeth, normal anatomy and physiology and the deviations.

name: Restorative
description: Broad term applied to any restorations to the tooth/teeth structure(s). Anterior teeth include up to five surface classifications - Mesial, Distal, Incisal, Lingual and Labial. Posterior teeth include up to five surface classifications: Mesial, Distal, Occlusal, Lingual and Buccal.

name: Endodontics
description: The branch of dentistry that is concerned with the morphology, physiology and pathology of the dental pulp and periradicular (gum) tissues.

name: Maxillofacial Prosthetics
description: The branch of prosthetics is concerned with the restoration of stomatognathic and associated facial structure that have been affected by disease, injury, surgery, or congenital defect.

name: Adjunctive Dental Services
description: Typically these services involve a drug such as anesthesia or other substances that serve as a supplemental purpose in dental therapy.

name: Plan Coverage and General Benefits
description: Plan coverage and general benefits for the member's policy or contract.

name: Chiropractic
description: Manipulations and modalities provided by a healthcare provider

name: Dental Care
description: The treatment of the teeth and their supporting structures.

name: Dental Crowns
description: An artificial replacement for the natural crown of the tooth covering all five surfaces (Anterior teeth surface classifications - Mesial, Distal, Incisal, Lingual and Labial. Posterior teeth surface classifications: Mesial, Distal, Occlusal, Lingual and Buccal.

name: Dental Accident
description: Supplies or appliances for care of teeth due to accidental injury provided by healthcare provider

name: Orthodontics
description: The area of dentistry concerned with the supervision, guidance, and correction of the growing and mature orofacial structures. This includes conditions that require movement of the teeth or correction of the malrelationships and malformations of related structures by the adjustment of relationships between and among teeth and facial bones by the application of forces or the stimulation and redirection of functional forces within the craniofacial complex.

name: Prosthodontics
description: The part of dentistry pertaining to the restoration and maintenance of oral function, comfort, appearance and health of the patient by replacement of missing teeth and contiguous tissues with artificial substitutes. It has three main branches: removable prosthodontics, fixed prosthodontics and maxillofacial prosthetics.

name: Oral Surgery
description: Diagnosis and treatment of disorders of the mouth, teeth, jaws and facial structure provided by a healthcare provider

name: Preventive Dental
description: The dental procedures in dental practice and health programs that prevent the occurrence of oral diseases.

name: Home Health Care
description: Healthcare services rendered in the home by a healthcare provider

name: Hospice
description: An integrated set of services and supplies to provide palliative and supportive care to terminally ill patients.

name: Hospitalization
description: Hospital Inpatient and Outpatient services and supplies for a patient who may or may not have been admitted to a hospital, for the purpose of receiving medical care or other health services.

name: Long Term Care
description: Care provided for an individual when they cannot care for themselves within the home or in a facility

name: Medically Related Transportation
description: Ambulance, Ambulate or other Medical transport services

name: Plan Coverage
description: Indicates whether a patient has active or inactive coverage for the service date requested.

name: In-vitro Fertilization
description: Services to treat infertility

name: MRI Scan
description: Diagnostic MRI (Magnetic Resonance Imaging) services.

name: Acupuncture
description: A system of alternative treatment that involves pricking the skin or tissues with needles

name: Newborn Care
description: Management of the infant during the transition to extra uterine life and subsequent period of stabilization

name: Pathology
description: Creation of slides from tissues and its interpretation provided by a healthcare provider

name: Smoking Cessation
description: Treatment to assist in the discontinuation of the use of nicotine

name: Well Baby Care
description: Medical services and physician visits which are recommended by the American Pediatric Association as appropriate and routine care for a child to a specific age limit.

name: Maternity
description: Services related to maternity care including related conditions resulting in childbirth when provided, or ordered and billed by a physician or nurse midwife

name: Transplants
description: Services related to the transfer of living organs or tissue from one body to another.

name: Audiology
description: Services related to hearing disorders, including evaluation of hearing function and rehabilitation of patients with hearing impairment

name: Private Duty Nursing
description: A nurse who is hired to provide focused care to an individual patient in a hospital, clinic, nursing home or patient's home

name: Prosthetics
description: A device that is used to replace a part of the body that is missing.

name: Dialysis
description: The process by which uric acid and urea are removed from circulating blood by means of a dialyzer

name: Chemotherapy
description: The treatment of disease by means of chemicals that have a specific toxic effect upon the disease-producing microorganisms or that selectively destroy cancerous tissue.

name: Allergy Testing
description: A skin or blood test to determine what substance, or allergen, may trigger an allergic response in a person

name: Immunizations
description: The introduction of a vaccine with the goal of producing immunity

name: Routine Physical
description: A physical examination performed on asymptomatic patients for medical screening purposes.

name: Family Planning
description: Educational services that assists individuals and couples to anticipate and attain their desired number of children and the spacing and timing of their births. It is achieved through use of contraceptive methods and the treatment of involuntary infertility.

name: Abortion
description: Services related to the elective termination of a pregnancy

name: Emergency Services
description: Services provided by healthcare providers for the treatment of a sudden and unexpected medical condition or injury which requires immediate medical attention

name: Retail/Independent Pharmacy
description: A licensed entity that dispenses prescription drugs and provides professional pharmacy services, such as clinical pharmacy consulting respective to the dispensing function. The entity may be a retail/chain or independent pharmacy or any other entity which dispenses prescription drugs.

name: Mail Order Pharmacy
description: A mail order pharmacy delivers medications directly to patients through the mail.

name: Brand Name Prescription Drug
description: The original formulation of a prescription drug, approved by the FDA for distribution.

name: Generic Prescription Drug
description: Generic drugs are copies of brand-name drugs that have exactly the same dosage, intended use, effects, side effects, route of administration, risks, safety, and strength as the original drug. In other words, their pharmacological effects are exactly the same as those of their brand-name counterparts.

name: Podiatry
description: Professional services of a physician or other healthcare provider for the care or treatment of conditions of the foot.

name: Psychotherapy
description: Professional services, including individual or group therapy by providers such as psychiatrists, psychologists, clinical social workers, or psychiatric nurses.

name: Occupational Therapy
description: Professional and facility occupational therapy services performed by an occupational therapist, physician or other healthcare provider at a hospital, office or other covered facility.

name: Speech Therapy
description: Professional and facility speech therapy services performed by a speech therapist, physician or other healthcare provider at a hospital, office or other covered facility.

name: Skilled Nursing Care
description: Services for a patient in a skilled nursing facility for the purpose of receiving medical care or other health services.

name: Substance Abuse
description: Services provided at a hospital, office or other covered facility as they are related to the diagnosis and treatment of Substance Abuse.

name: Optometry
description: Routine vision services furnished by an optometrist. May include coverage for eyeglasses, contact lenses, routine eye exams, and/or vision testing for the prescribing or fitting of eyeglasses or contact lenses.

name: Frames
description: The framework for a pair of eyeglasses

name: Lenses
description: A piece of transparent substance having two opposite surfaces either both curved or one curved and one plane, used in an optical device in correcting defects of vision.

name: Routine Eye Exam
description: A series of tests to evaluate an individual's vision and check for eye diseases.

name: Nonmedically Necessary Physical (These physicals are required by other entities e.g., insurance application, pilot license, employment or school)
description: A physical examination performed on asymptomatic patients for medical screening purposes.

name: Brand Name Prescription Drug - Formulary
description: Lists of brand name drugs covered and published by the health plan/payer/processor/PBM to help physicians reach clinically and economically appropriate prescribing decisions for patients.

name: Brand Name Prescription Drug - Non-Formulary
description: A brand name drug that is not listed on the covered and published list of the health plan/payer/processor/PBM.

name: Massage Therapy
description: The manipulation of muscles and other soft tissues of the body by a therapist for the treatment of health conditions such as pain, cancer, fibromyalgia, HIV/AIDS, depression.

name: Pulmonary Rehabilitation
description: Services and instructional guidance administered to an individual suffering from respiratory disease in an attempt to improve the quality of life for the patient.

name: Cardiac Rehabilitation
description: Services and instructional guidance rendered by a physician or other healthcare provider in a hospital or covered facility that are designed to help an individual recover from a cardiovascular event

name: Gynecological
description: Medical care and management of the female reproductive system and associated disorders provided by a physician or other healthcare provider.

name: Obstetrical
description: Medical care and management related to the care of a woman prior, during and after pregnancy, provided by a physician or other healthcare provider.

name: Physician Visit - Sick
description: Professional services rendered by a physician or other healthcare provider during a non-routine visit related to a illness.

name: Physician Visit - Well
description: Professional services rendered by a physician or other healthcare provider during a routine or preventative care visit.

name: Screening X-ray
description: X-ray services provided by a physician or other healthcare provider for the purpose of preventative care.

name: Screening laboratory
description: Laboratory services provided by a physician or other healthcare provider for the purpose of preventative care.

name: Mammogram, High Risk Patient
description: Mammography services for patients that have been identified with a greater than normal risk for breast cancers and related diseases.

name: Mammogram, Low Risk Patient
description: Mammography services for patients that have been identified with a normal risk for breast cancers and related diseases.

name: Flu Vaccination
description: Services provided by a physician or other healthcare provider related to the administration of influenza virus vaccination.

name: Dermatology
description: Services provided by a physician or other healthcare provider involving the skin and its diseases.

name: Diabetic Supplies
description: Blood sugar (glucose) test strips, monitors, insulin, lancet devices and lancets, glucose control solutions used to monitor and assist in the treatment of diabetes.

name: Applied Behavioral Analysis Therapy
description: Services related to the assessment and treatment of learning and/or developmental disabilities to include techniques and principles to bring about meaningful and positive changes in behavior, improve attention, focus, memory, academics and/or increase language, communication and social skills.

name: Radiographs
description: An image or picture produced on a radiation-sensitive film emulsion by exposure to ionizing radiation direct through an area, region, or substance of interest, followed by chemical processing of the film

name: Diagnostic Imaging
description: The use of radiographic, sonographic, and other technologies to create a graphic depiction of the body parts in question.

name: Fixed Prosthodontics
description: The branch of prosthodontics concerned with the replacement or restoration of teeth by artificial substitutes that are not readily removable such as fixed partial dentures, pontics and abutments.

name: Removable Prosthodontics
description: The branch of prosthodontics concerned with the replacement or restoration of teeth by artificial substitutes that are readily removable such as a denture, partial denture and interim prosthesis.

name: Intraoral Images - Complete Series
description: Complete set of images using radiographic, sonographic, and other technologies representing an image or set of images within the oral cavity.

name: Oral Evaluation
description: The art and science of evaluation to make a clinical judgment or appraisal of a patient's dental health or condition.

name: Dental Prophylaxis
description: A series of procedures where plaque, calculus, and stain are removed from the teeth often referred to as "prophy" or teeth cleaning.

name: Panoramic Images
description: A tomogram of the jaws, taken with a specialized machine designed to present a panoramic view of the full circumferential length of the jaws on a single film.

name: Sealants
description: A resinous material designed for application to the occlusal surfaces of posterior teeth to seal the surface irregularities and prevent the carious process.

name: Fluoride Treatments
description: A separate process from dental prophylaxis of applying prescription strength fluoride product designed to prevent caries.

name: Dental Implants
description: A device, usually alloplastic, that is surgically inserted into or onto the oral tissue. To be used as a prosthodontic abutment, it should remain quiescent and purely secondary to local tissue physiology.

name: Temporomandibular Joint Dysfunction
description: Services related to the Impaired function of the temporomandibular articulation of the jaw.

name: Retail Pharmacy Prescription Drug
description: Dispenses prescription drugs and provides professional pharmacy services, such as clinical pharmacy consulting respective to the dispensing function. The entity may be a retail/chain or independent pharmacy or any other entity which dispenses prescription drugs.

name: Long Term Care Pharmacy
description: Long term care pharmacy serve the residents of nursing homes, assisted care facilities, extended care facilities, retirement homes, or post acute care. These are considered "closed door pharmacies"

name: Dietary/Nutritional Services
description: Nutrition and diet counseling such as: weight management, eating disorders, pregnancy, pediatric, food allergy, diabetes, celiac disease

name: Intensive Cardiac Rehabilitation
description: A group of physical activities designed to help a patient recover from a cardiovascular event

name: Convenience Care
description: A category of walk-in clinic located in retail stores, supermarkets and pharmacies that treat uncomplicated minor illnesses

name: Telemedicine
description: Services provided via telecommunication and/or information technology venues to provide clinical health services.
technicalNote: Services performed that are related to telemedicine; not a place of service.

name: Pharmacist Services
description: Clinical services provided by a pharmacist

name: Diabetic Education
description: Patient educational program designed to bring awareness of diabetes, what it takes to treat it, and the necessary changes that should be made to improve their lifestyle.

name: Early Intervention
description: Services related to treatment for babies or toddlers with developmental delays or disabilities.

name: Preventive Services
description: Preventive services such as check-ups, patient counseling and screenings to prevent illness, disease and other health-related problems.

name: Specialty Pharmacy
description: Specialty pharmacies are designed to efficiently deliver medications with specialized handling, storage, and distribution requirements. Specialty pharmacies are also designed to improve clinical and economic outcomes for patients with complex, often chronic and rare conditions, with close contact and management by clinicians.

name: Durable Medical Equipment New
description: New equipment needed for medical reasons to be used by a person that is ill or injured and is ordered by a health care provider for use in the home.

name: CAT Scan
description: A multi-dimensional diagnostic image of a cross section of the body that is useful in diagnosing disease

name: Contact Lenses
description: A thin lens placed directly on the surface of the eye. Contact Lenses are considered medical devices

name: Medically Tailored Meals (MTM)
description: Meals approved by a medical professional or healthcare plan that reflect appropriate dietary therapy for the individual

name: IV Therapy
description: Intravenous (IV) therapy is a medical technique of administering fluids directly into a vein.

name: Generic Prescription Drug - Formulary
description: Lists of generic drugs covered and published by the health plan/payer/processor/PBM to help physicians reach clinically and economically appropriate prescribing decisions for patients.

name: Generic Prescription Drug - Non-Formulary
description: A generic drug that is not listed on the covered and published list of the health plan/payer/processor/PBM.

name: Mental Health
description: Mental Health services provided by a physician or other healthcare providers who are trained and educated to perform services related to mental health and may be licensed or practice within the scope or licensure or training.

name: Positron Emission Tomography (PET) Scan
description: A nuclear imaging examination which reveals molecular function and activity.

name: Physical Therapy
description: Services and care related to evaluation and treatment of injury or disorders

name: Serious Mental Health
description: Services for disorders characterized by severe deficits and pervasive impairment in multiple areas of development.

name: Urgent Care
description: Medical services and supplies provided by physicians or other healthcare providers for the treatment of an urgent medical condition or injury which requires medical attention.

name: Remote Patient Monitoring
description: A telehealth method using digital devices to collect patient health data and transmit to their provider.

name: Remote Therapeutic Monitoring
description: Services involving the remote collection, transmission, and clinical use of non-physiologic therapeutic data to monitor patient progress and adjust treatment plans. For example, musculoskeletal, respiratory, or other therapy-related metrics.

name: Special Supplemental Benefits
description: Additional non-medical benefits provided to a member by their health plan. Examples may include over-the-counter (OTC) drugs, plan-approved food items, and/or utilities.

name: Dental Sleep Related Breathing Disorders and Airway Management Services
description: Services for the treatment, adjustment, and ongoing management of sleep-related breathing disorders (SRBD), including airway management procedures and oral appliance therapy (OAT).
